001package com.streamConverter.command.impl.csv;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule;
005import com.streamConverter.path.CSVPath;
006import java.io.BufferedReader;
007import java.io.IOException;
008import java.io.InputStream;
009import java.io.InputStreamReader;
010import java.io.OutputStream;
011import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
012import java.io.Writer;
013import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
014
015/**
016 * CSV Navigate Command Class
017 *
018 * <p>This class implements command for targeted CSV transformation using column selectors. It
019 * identifies specific columns using column names or indices and applies IRule transformations to
020 * those columns while preserving the overall CSV structure.
021 */
022public class CsvNavigateCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
023
024  private final CSVPath columnSelector;
025  private final IRule rule;
026  private int columnIndex = -1;
027
028  // Deprecated fields for backward compatibility
029  @Deprecated private final String legacyColumnSelector;
030
031  /**
032   * Constructor for CSV navigation with column selector and transformation rule.
033   *
034   * @param columnSelector the column name or index to select (e.g., "name", "2")
035   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected column
036   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector or rule is null
037   * @deprecated Use {@link #CsvNavigateCommand(CSVPath, IRule)} instead
038   */
039  @Deprecated
040  public CsvNavigateCommand(String columnSelector, IRule rule) {
041    if (columnSelector == null) {
042      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selector cannot be null");
043    }
044    if (rule == null) {
045      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
046    }
047    this.legacyColumnSelector = columnSelector;
048    this.columnSelector = new CSVPath(columnSelector);
049    this.rule = rule;
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Constructor for CSV navigation with typed column selector and transformation rule.
054   *
055   * @param columnSelector the typed CSVPath to select column
056   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected column
057   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector or rule is null
058   */
059  public CsvNavigateCommand(CSVPath columnSelector, IRule rule) {
060    if (columnSelector == null) {
061      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selector cannot be null");
062    }
063    if (rule == null) {
064      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
065    }
066    this.columnSelector = columnSelector;
067    this.legacyColumnSelector = columnSelector.toString();
068    this.rule = rule;
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Factory method for creating a CSV navigation command with explicit rule specification. This
073   * method makes the intention explicit: extract data from the specified column and apply the given
074   * transformation rule.
075   *
076   * @param columnSelector the column name or index to select (e.g., "name", "2")
077   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected column data
078   * @return a CsvNavigateCommand that extracts the specified column with the given rule
079   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
080   * @deprecated Use {@link #create(CSVPath, IRule)} instead
081   */
082  @Deprecated
083  public static CsvNavigateCommand create(String columnSelector, IRule rule) {
084    return new CsvNavigateCommand(columnSelector, rule);
085  }
086
087  /**
088   * Factory method for creating a CSV navigation command with typed column selector and rule.
089   *
090   * @param columnSelector the typed CSVPath to select column
091   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected column data
092   * @return a CsvNavigateCommand that extracts the specified column with the given rule
093   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
094   */
095  public static CsvNavigateCommand create(CSVPath columnSelector, IRule rule) {
096    return new CsvNavigateCommand(columnSelector, rule);
097  }
098
099  @Override
100  protected String getCommandDetails() {
101    return String.format(
102        "CsvNavigateCommand(columnSelector='%s', rule='%s')",
103        columnSelector.toString(), rule.getClass().getSimpleName());
104  }
105
106  @Override
107  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
108      throws IOException {
109    try (BufferedReader reader =
110            new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
111        Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
112
113      // Apply rule to specific column while preserving structure
114      applyRuleToColumn(reader, writer);
115    }
116  }
117
118  /** Apply transformation rule to specific column while preserving CSV structure */
119  private void applyRuleToColumn(BufferedReader reader, Writer writer) throws IOException {
120    String headerLine = reader.readLine();
121    if (headerLine == null) {
122      return; // Empty input
123    }
124
125    String[] headers = parseCSVLine(headerLine);
126
127    // Determine column index if selector is provided
128    columnIndex = resolveColumnIndex(headers, columnSelector);
129    if (columnIndex == -1) {
130      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column not found: " + columnSelector.toString());
131    }
132
133    // Write header (unchanged)
134    writer.write(headerLine);
135    writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
136
137    // Process data rows
138    String line;
139    while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
140      String[] values = parseCSVLine(line);
141
142      if (columnIndex < values.length) {
143        // Apply rule to target column only
144        values[columnIndex] = rule.apply(values[columnIndex]);
145      }
146
147      // Write entire row with transformed column (with proper CSV escaping)
148      writer.write(formatCsvRow(values));
149      writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
150    }
151    writer.flush();
152  }
153
154  private String[] parseCSVLine(String line) {
155    return line.split(",(?=([^\"]*\"[^\"]*\")*[^\"]*$)");
156  }
157
158  /** Format CSV row with proper escaping */
159  private String formatCsvRow(String[] values) {
160    StringBuilder row = new StringBuilder();
161    for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
162      if (i > 0) {
163        row.append(",");
164      }
165      row.append(escapeCsvValue(values[i]));
166    }
167    return row.toString();
168  }
169
170  /** Escape CSV value according to CSV standards */
171  private String escapeCsvValue(String value) {
172    if (value == null) {
173      return "";
174    }
175
176    // Check if value needs escaping (contains comma, quote, or newline)
177    if (value.contains(",")
178        || value.contains("\"")
179        || value.contains("\n")
180        || value.contains("\r")) {
181      // Escape quotes by doubling them and wrap entire value in quotes
182      return "\"" + value.replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"";
183    }
184
185    return value;
186  }
187
188  // This method is now deprecated as CSVPath handles index resolution
189  @Deprecated
190  private int findColumnIndex(String[] headers, String selector) {
191    // Try to find by column name
192    for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
193      if (headers[i].trim().equalsIgnoreCase(selector.trim())) {
194        return i;
195      }
196    }
197
198    // Try to parse as column index
199    try {
200      int index = Integer.parseInt(selector);
201      if (index >= 0 && index < headers.length) {
202        return index;
203      }
204    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
205      // Not a number, ignore
206    }
207
208    return -1;
209  }
210
211  /** Resolve column index using CSVPath matches() method */
212  private int resolveColumnIndex(String[] headers, CSVPath csvPath) {
213    // Use matches() method to check each column
214    for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
215      if (csvPath.matches(headers, i)) {
216        return i;
217      }
218    }
219    return -1; // Not found
220  }
221}
